survivors.q: Who captained Olympiacos in the 2024 UEFA Europa Conference League final and lifted the trophy?
survivors.hint: Kostas Fortounis started the final wearing the armband and was the first to raise the trophy after Ayoub El Kaabi's 116th-minute header settled it 1-0 in extra time against Fiorentina — the first European title for Olympiacos and for Greek club football.

survivors.q: Which club did Olympiacos beat 6-2 on aggregate in the semi-finals on the way to the 2024 Conference League title?
survivors.hint: A 4-2 win at Villa Park and a 2-0 second leg at home made it 6-2 on aggregate against Aston Villa.

survivors.q: Before moving to Germany, Kostas Fortounis broke into the Greek top flight with which club?
survivors.hint: Fortounis scored his first Super League goal for Asteras Tripolis in 2010-11, the season before he left for Kaiserslautern.

survivors.q: Olympiacos supporters call the club 'Thrylos'. What does the nickname mean?
survivors.hint: Thrylos translates as 'The Legend', the club's best-known nickname alongside Erythrolefkoi, the Red-Whites.

survivors.q: Which coach, appointed only in February 2024, led Olympiacos to the Conference League title that season?
survivors.hint: José Luis Mendilibar took charge on 11 February 2024, months after winning the Europa League with Sevilla, and lifted the Conference League in May.

survivors.q: Tottenham led 2-0 at the Karaiskakis in Olympiacos's opening game of the 2019-20 Champions League group stage before the hosts drew 2-2. Who scored the equaliser from the penalty spot?
survivors.hint: Mathieu Valbuena converted the penalty on 54 minutes after Daniel Podence had pulled one back just before half-time.

survivors.q: From which German club did Olympiacos sign Kostas Fortounis in 2014?
survivors.hint: He spent three seasons with the Red Devils of the Fritz-Walter-Stadion, who were in the 2. Bundesliga by the time he left for Piraeus.

survivors.q: Vasilis Torosidis scored the winner in Greece's first ever World Cup victory, at South Africa 2010. Who were the opponents?
survivors.hint: Torosidis struck on 71 minutes as Greece beat 10-man Nigeria 2-1 on 17 June 2010 for their first win at a World Cup.

survivors.q: Olympiacos beat Manchester United 2-0 at the Karaiskakis Stadium in the first leg of the 2013-14 Champions League round of 16. Who opened the scoring before half-time?
survivors.hint: Alejandro Domínguez turned in Giannis Maniatis's effort on 38 minutes to start the 2-0 win on 25 February 2014.

survivors.q: Where was the 2024 UEFA Conference League final, won by Olympiacos, played?
survivors.hint: The final was staged at the Agia Sophia Stadium, AEK Athens's ground, so Olympiacos won Greece's first European trophy in their own city but not at their own stadium.

survivors.q: Which coach was in charge of Olympiacos for their 2013-14 Champions League campaign?
survivors.hint: Míchel, the former Real Madrid and Spain midfielder, was Olympiacos head coach in 2013-14 and took them to the round of 16.

survivors.q: In Olympiacos's 2-0 win over Manchester United in the 2013-14 round of 16, the second goal was scored by a forward spending the season on loan from Arsenal. Who was he?
survivors.hint: Costa Rica forward Joel Campbell, on loan at Olympiacos from Arsenal, made it 2-0 on 54 minutes.

survivors.q: Who scored the goal that won Olympiacos the 2024 Conference League final against Fiorentina?
survivors.hint: Ayoub El Kaabi headed in Santiago Hezze's cross in the 116th minute to settle the final 1-0 in Athens.

survivors.q: Vasilis Torosidis left Olympiacos in January 2013 to join which Italian club?
survivors.hint: The Greek right-back headed for a club in the Italian capital, and only left three and a half seasons later when Bologna signed him in 2016.

survivors.q: Before taking the Olympiacos job in 2018, Pedro Martins had most recently managed which Portuguese club?
survivors.hint: He spent a season and a half in the Minho, taking that side to the 2017 Taça de Portugal final before walking away in February 2018; at Olympiacos he went on to win three straight Greek titles.

survivors.q: Olympiacos knocked Arsenal out of the 2019-20 Europa League on away goals, winning 2-1 at the Emirates with a goal in the 119th minute. Who scored it?
survivors.hint: Youssef El Arabi struck in the 119th minute on 27 February 2020 to send Olympiacos through 2-2 on away goals.

survivors.q: Olympiacos won 3-2 away to Arsenal in the Champions League group stage in September 2015. Which Arsenal goalkeeper, picked ahead of Petr Čech, dropped a corner over his own line?
survivors.hint: Arsène Wenger selected David Ospina instead of Petr Čech, and Ospina's errors — including a corner spilled over his line — helped Olympiacos win 3-2 at the Emirates.

survivors.q: Olympiacos carried a 2-0 lead to Old Trafford in the 2013-14 round of 16 second leg but lost 3-0. Whose hat-trick knocked them out?
survivors.hint: Robin van Persie scored all three — a penalty, a close-range finish and a free-kick — as Manchester United went through 3-2 on aggregate on 19 March 2014.

survivors.q: What is the Olympiacos v Panathinaikos fixture commonly called in English?
survivors.hint: Olympiacos v Panathinaikos is known as the Derby of the Eternal Enemies, a rivalry rooted in working-class Piraeus, where Olympiacos were founded in 1925, against the old Athenian society of Panathinaikos in the city centre.

survivors.q: Yaya Touré returned to Olympiacos in September 2018 but was released three months later after only five appearances. Who was the coach who left him out?
survivors.hint: Touré failed to convince Pedro Martins and his contract was terminated by mutual agreement in December 2018.

survivors.q: Yaya Touré's first spell at Olympiacos began in 2005, when he arrived from which Ukrainian club?
survivors.hint: Touré signed from Metalurh Donetsk in 2005, won the Greek league and cup double, then left for Monaco in the summer of 2006.
